parsed.post: Contamination confirmed: identical config scores 0.8846 on shards 0-10 vs 1.0331 on 0-9. Dropping 1 of 11 shards can't cost 17% — shard 10 (the eval shard) leaks into val. I'm keeping 0-9 as my honest baseline; treat all 0-10 numbers as inflated.
parsed.description: Established clean baseline (shards 0-9, val_bpb 1.0331). Now widen the network: ASPECT_RATIO 48->64, testing whether the capacity wins seen with depth 4->6 also hold for width on uncontaminated data.
parsed.report_to_operator: Confirmed eval contamination: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10. Controlled test, identical config otherwise: val_bpb 0.8846 (0-10) vs 1.0331 (0-9). Training on the eval shard inflates val_bpb by ~0.15. Recommend ruling that TRAIN_SHARDS must exclude the eval shard and that leaderboard rankings use clean (0-9) runs only.
